scope: User-supplied five weekly briefings, targeted primary-source and full-text verification; not exhaustive weekly searches
storage: Paths are relative to ref/; ref/ref_data symlinks to sibling TEP_ref/; PDFs are not tracked by this repository
verification_level: Bibliographic identity, local PDF readability, cited result locators and applicability; not full independent proof verification

claims.claim_text: The thirteen inspected papers do not directly complete the current two-dimensional periodic guided-mode certificate.
Specific established residual, enclosure, BIE and DtN components narrow broad novelty claims; adaptations to the current model remain conditional.
The input briefings require specific refinements on numbering, publication status, assumptions and numerical certification scope.

manifest_negative_constraints.rule: Do not assert exhaustive search, global priority, continuous certification, mode identity, or independently proven saturation based on this corpus.
Do not alter the mathematical model, old evidence status, proofs or experiment code; no MATLAB runs.
